pr_title: feat(video): cute-cartoon and cute-mystery explainers are written from their own series' prompts; flat-explainer's prompts do not move
summary:
WORK ORDER, pull request 3 of 3 for tasks/open/2026-10-10-explainer-route-takes-a-series-look.md. Designed against 6a26eff42707603d8f80586ae0efb7c85a13fe15 (the script's MAIN 599835f49 plus #1421, #1423, #1428: #1421 rewrote only the slides planner paragraph of prompts.mjs, which moves instructionsFor from line 769 to 772 and EXPLAINER_COMMON to 1441; #1423 added five lines to flow.mjs above settle). Nothing in the repository was changed. Paths are repository-relative because they must be read at that commit and must match the keys of REVIEW_FILES. Notes, the prototype and the checks are in <scratch>\explainer\pr3-prompts (prompt-texts.md, pr3-on-6a26eff.diff, verify-pr3.mjs, n-main/, n-pr1/, n-pr3/).

WHAT THIS PULL REQUEST DOES. A cute-cartoon one-off is planned, written, checked and discussed as 原來如此事務所 in its new look, a cute-mystery one-off as 奇聞檔案局, each under prompt variants of its own; flat-explainer keeps its variants, its instructions, its payloads, its judge and its lint byte for byte. The two presets join the request form on /admin/videos (pull request 1 held them back for this).

1. VARIANTS, ONE TABLE. New file tools/video/automation/explainer-series.mjs holds EXPLAINER_VARIANTS, keyed by preset: flat-explainer -> bible "bible-explainer", stage "explainer", discuss "discuss" (all three as today); cute-cartoon -> "bible-explainer-cartoon", "explainer-cartoon", "discuss-cartoon"; cute-mystery -> "bible-explainer-mystery", "explainer-mystery", "discuss-mystery". flow.mjs variantOf, series.mjs documentVariant and the two discussion calls of discuss.mjs read it; no site keeps a literal. Names match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$; the tighter limit is VideoAiRun.stage String(32), which stores "<stage>/<variant>": "planner/bible-explainer-cartoon" and "-mystery" are 31, and a test pins the 32. The new texts share NO constant with the existing ones (EXPLAINER_COMMON and EXPLAINER_SHOT_GUIDE say "flat editorial illustrations", "burned-in subtitles", "No mascot or recurring character", "anonymous figures", `"preset": "flat-explainer"`, each wrong for the cute looks): they are composed from new constants in the new file, so prompts.mjs's texts are not touched and cannot drift. No `planner:explainer-<x>` text exists on purpose (the legacy brief planner only takes request rows with no series; a cute request is always a series row).

2. THE PROFILE REGISTRY, IN THE INSTRUCTIONS. EXPLAINER_SERIES_PROFILES (same file) is keyed by preset and holds: series name, docs path, which thumbnail the series wears, pillars (id, name, thumbnail tag), the opening, the content rules, the look allowances, the episode shape, the thumbnail, title and description guides, the music line, the bible's sections and body_json, what the checker flags, what a discussion refuses. Shared blocks: common(profile), PICTURE_RULES (the shot-prompt rules measured on the four pilots), cardRules(cards), LINE_RULES, SHORTS, FIXING, NO_PAGES, FORM_FIELDS. The brief enters through the INSTRUCTIONS, never the payload: no key is added to any payload, seriesFacts is not edited, so documentInputs and every durable key of an existing run stay what they are. The one payload change is a value for the new presets only: documentPayload sends genre_spec null for a profiled explainer (today a one-off row carries the form's default genre "xianxia-bonds", and the bible planner of an explainer is handed the 仙俠羈絆 genre spec and a genre section in its instructions; flat-explainer keeps both, byte for byte).

3. 奇聞檔案局's BIBLE KEEPS THE QUESTION SHAPE (owner's decision 2). The planner is told that 原因 is the evidence chapters: 「流傳的版本：…」 once and first, 「紀錄：…」 two to four times oldest first, 「目前最站得住的解釋：…」 once and last; outline.reasons are those 4 to 6 labelled sentences; outline.closing starts with 存檔 or 未結; outline.pillar is H, M, P, U or L. documentProblem (series.mjs:78) and _explainer_bible_problem (series.py:222) ask only for characters [], non-empty acts, an outline object with question, answer, hook, at least two non-empty reasons and https sources: such a bible passes both unchanged, and "pillar" is read by nobody but the writer (grep: no reader in apps/api or the tools outside the prompt). Proved by the end-to-end test below, where brief.md comes out as "## 原因" with the four labelled lines.

4. THUMBNAILS. cute-mystery: the writer is told the channel's thumb (headline at most 6 counted characters on one line or two of at most 3, a number or Latin word counts one and at most two of those, tag exactly one of 歷史懸案, 奇異現象, 預言, 外星與太空, 都市傳說, sub, shot; no "pillar", "layout", "tone" or "variants"). Proof it validates after pull request 1 makes thumbnailSeries null for the preset: templates.mjs thumbnailProblems with series null accepts that object and refuses "pillar" ("must be one of business, science, travel, tech") and layout "right" ("must be one of a, b, c"); lint thumbnailHeadlineProblems (lint.mjs:354) returns [] for 「光？\n**先到**」; the HTML has no 原來如此事務所, no stamp and no pillar class. settle() never writes doc.thumbnail (flow.mjs:446-520 has no assignment to it), pinned by the end-to-end test (thumbnail deep-equals what the writer wrote). cute-cartoon: the series thumbnail exactly as flat-explainer's guide, plus "the one beats.pillar names".

5. CARDS. The new writers are offered title, chapter, big, stats, compare, steps, table, outro and are told no photo, screenshot, diagram, screencast, quote or bullets. validateDrama's allow-list becomes per preset: explainerCardTemplates(preset) returns EXPLAINER_CARD_TEMPLATES plus "steps" and "table" for the two cute presets and EXPLAINER_CARD_TEMPLATES itself (unchanged, six names) for flat-explainer. This widens only what the renderer already draws for format "drama": render/plan.mjs renderPlan and assemble/drama.mjs layoutDrama give a steps and a table card the same "stills" states per reveal as stats (run on 6a26eff42: how=stills/2, names=stills/2). The pilots used exactly these eight. Ticket 2026-10-10-host-writer-prompt-forbids-photo is NOT folded in: it is about the slides writer's TEMPLATE_GUIDE sentence near prompts.mjs:168 and says itself that drama and explainer formats are not affected.

6. PICTURES. Recommendation: judge a cute explainer with the nine yes/no checks, and apply the picture-variety lint. keyframes.mjs:519 becomes `(slides || isCuteExplainer(doc)) && Boolean(status.limits?.judge_checks)`; flat-explainer stays on the scored rubric. Reason: the three pilots were judged with those nine checks under these very looks (look.md: most takes 9.29, the rejected ones were real drift: realism, 3D, bars, a face on a lone object), while the scored rubric tops out at 7 against a bar of 7 and flips on a re-ask. Cost of being wrong: with checks, a question that misfires on the look (the "generated" check names "an even outline traced around everything", which the look asks for; it costs 6 of 10 on a weight of 2 and did not sink the pilots) redraws at US$0.0135 a take and three takes a shot, slow but cheap, and ends at the owner's keyframe gate, not a hard block; with the rubric, every picture sits on the bar and the video stalls at the picture gate. pictureVarietyProblems covers the two cute presets (three stills in a row under one move is a lint error the free repair round fixes; no shot size, look words restated, more than half at night and a repeated motif are warnings), with one added word list for the cute medium (cartoon, chibi, kawaii, anime, cel-shaded, flat colours, thick outlines). The three pilots' 228 shot prompts (75, 61, 92) give 0 errors and 0 warnings under it and restate none of the cute look words.

7. DISCUSSION. Today the owner's line on an explainer's bible goes to "planner:discuss" and on its script to "writer:discuss", both the story drama's texts (cast, dialogue, acts of a story) plus, for the planner, the genre section. Smallest change: documentDiscussVariant(series) and scriptDiscussVariant(state) pick "discuss-cartoon" / "discuss-mystery" for the two profiled presets and "discuss" for everything else, flat-explainer included; the two new texts per series restate the series' bible shape or shot guide and refuse a cast, dialogue and (mystery) a legend told as fact. SCRIPT_DISCUSSION_VARIANTS gains the two names so a pending discussion writer is still recognised (flow.mjs:1167).

ALSO DECIDED HERE: settle() reduces a profiled series' look to { preset } (a writer's own style or negative would replace the look, and image-01 reads a negative as more prompt; flat-explainer keeps what the writer added, as today); the writer's two Shorts are drafted for every explainer stage variant (flow.mjs:3044 compared with the literal "explainer").

BYTE-STABILITY (measured on scratch copies of 6a26eff42: n-main, and n-pr3 = main + the pull request 1 prototype + this design). instructionsFor SHA-256, identical on both: planner bible-explainer 55ffd024…4391a90, planner explainer 32b471d9…9451ed, writer explainer 185af9a7…03e72, verifier explainer c1619a92…52842, planner discuss 88d7f551…2cab9, writer discuss 06c8d01e…0c0a6, planner bible-explainer with a one-off row carrying genre xianxia-bonds 4dd130e4…7a298, planner discuss with that row 29078b6d…242f4, writer explainer with standing and stance 14c4507a…f83ba (full digests in prompt-texts.md section 5; the same nine values as at 599835f49). documentInputs of a fixed flat-explainer bible job ac596d84…0eeb and the SHA-256 of its canonical documentPayload bea8c81b…3840; an ink-wash one-off 3a3a70b1…9967 and e7bdcfac…8d3d: identical on both. VARIANT_INSTRUCTIONS keeps its 21 keys. No file read into a payload by prompts.mjs references() is edited (script-writing.md, formats.md, docs/videos/README.md, drama.md, series.md, the showcase, minimal and drama fixtures): pull request 2's critique found that an edit to .agents/skills/youtube-video/references/drama.md moves the durable key of every drama-format stage, so this order edits none of them and documents the change in docs/videos/DRAMA-FLOW.md, which no payload reads and the receipt does not bind.

VERIFICATION DONE HERE on 6a26eff42: verify-pr3.mjs (seven groups) passes on n-pr3; ten test files (prompts, series, discuss, run-receipts, core drama, lint, explainer, look-keyframes, templates, qa thumbnail) give 284 passes and 6 failures on n-main and 286 passes and the same 6 failures on n-pr3 (the 6 are long-anime tests that need docs the copy lacks; the 2 extra passes are the new end-to-end and judge tests); the explainer, discussion, one-off and settle tests of automation.test.mjs and discuss.test.mjs pass 17 of 17 on both. NOT done: the whole of automation.test.mjs did not finish inside the time limit on either copy (no failure in the 147 to 151 tests that ran), the web change was not executed, and no host model has read the new texts.
